title: Percent as text
prompt: Return the fraction done as a percentage string with no decimals: 0.5 gives "50%", 0.25 gives "25%".
hints: Multiply by 100, make it a whole number, then text.

docs.name: int(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as a whole number; decimals are dropped, text like "42" is read.

docs.name: str(value)
docs.what: Returns the value as text (a String).

docs.name: text + text
docs.what: Joins two strings. Joining text to a number is an error; convert first.
